# nüll.

nüll. is a Mannheim-based web design and digital acquisition studio for professional service businesses, consultants, law firms, medical practices, and local companies in Germany.

## Website
- Canonical domain: https://nuell-agentur.com
- Brand spelling: nüll.
- Location: Mannheim, Germany
- Contact email: info@nüll.com
- WhatsApp: +49 1525 6569852

## Primary Pages
- https://nuell-agentur.com/ - Main page: websites, SEO, Google Ads, AI search visibility and content for local businesses.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/leistungen - Overview of all services.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/leistungen/webdesign - Web design: websites built to turn visitors into enquiries (form, call, WhatsApp).
- https://nuell-agentur.com/leistungen/seo - SEO: local visibility on Google and Google Maps.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/leistungen/google-ads - Google Ads: campaign setup, landing pages and conversion tracking.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/leistungen/ki-sichtbarkeit - AI visibility: being recommended by ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/leistungen/content - Content: videos and posts for the website and Instagram.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/referenzen - Client case studies.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/preise - Prices.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/website-check - Free website check with an emailed report.
- https://nuell-agentur.com/blog - Articles about websites, SEO, Google Ads and marketing for local businesses.

## Services
- Conversion-focused websites with clear structure and premium visual direction.
- Local SEO and search-intent page architecture for qualified organic visibility.
- Google Ads campaign setup, landing pages, and conversion tracking.
- AI search visibility and digital positioning for expert-led businesses.
- Brand, content, and trust-building systems for lead generation.

## Technical Notes
- Framework: React Router 7 with Vite.
- Rendering: SSR-enabled React application with static public SEO files.
- Sitemap: https://nuell-agentur.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://nuell-agentur.com/robots.txt

## Positioning
nüll. builds digital presences that help visitors quickly understand expertise, trust the provider, and take the next step toward a qualified inquiry.
